backend/main.mo: Main actor for the media-sharing canister; manages videos, photos, comments, likes, user profiles, ratings, subscriptions, ad revenue, and Stripe integration using mixins for storage and authorization.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades the actor state by adding empty `adRevenue` and `creatorRevenue` maps to the existing state shape.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two implemented features: fixing the Stripe premium subscription flow end-to-end, and adding an ad revenue dashboard UI with per-video impression tracking.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated summary document describing the purpose and key changes of each frontend source file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind layers and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Media Share SPA, setting metadata, favicon links, and mounting the React app via `/src/main.tsx`.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines all TanStack Router routes and the root layout, wiring pages like Home, VideoPlayer, Settings, Profile, Upgrade, PaymentSuccess, and PaymentFailure into a single router.
frontend/src/components/AdRevenueDashboa: Displays an ad revenue dashboard for authenticated uploaders, showing total earnings, number of monetized videos, CPM rate, and a per-video revenue breakdown table using data from ad revenue and video hooks.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Thin wrapper component that renders the ProfileDropdownMenu for use in the site header.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed mobile bottom navigation bar with links to Home, Upload, Shorts, and Subscriptions, plus a Profile tab that opens a dropdown menu, with active-state highlighting.
frontend/src/components/ChannelNameDispl: Displays a channel name as a clickable link to the channel page, fetching the name via hook and showing a truncated principal if no custom name is set.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Renders a comment section for a video with a submission form for authenticated users and a list of existing comments showing author, timestamp, and content.
frontend/src/components/DeleteVideoButto: Button component that triggers a confirmation AlertDialog before deleting a video, using the useDeleteVideo hook and supporting configurable variant/size props.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout component providing a sticky header with search, upload, and auth buttons, a collapsible sidebar, bottom navigation, main content area, and a footer with social links.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCard.tsx: Card component that displays a photo's thumbnail, title, uploader channel name, and upload date, navigating to the photo detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/ProfileDropdownM: A dropdown menu component for user profile management that handles authentication state, multi-account switching, and displays user initials/avatar using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users to set up their profile with a display name and optional channel name, blocking interaction until submitted.
frontend/src/components/ShareButton.tsx: A simple button component that copies the current page URL to the clipboard and shows a toast notification on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: A responsive sidebar navigation component with Home, Trending, and Library links, supporting mobile overlay and close behavior.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetupModal: A modal dialog for configuring Stripe payment integration by entering a secret key and allowed countries, used to enable premium subscriptions.
frontend/src/components/TagInput.tsx: An input component for managing a list of tags, supporting adding via Enter/comma and removing via backspace or click.
frontend/src/components/ThumbnailSelecto: A component that auto-generates video thumbnail candidates by seeking through the video at set intervals and allows users to select one or upload a custom JPEG/PNG thumbnail.
frontend/src/components/UpgradePrompt.ts: A card component that displays a premium upgrade prompt with feature benefits, shown only to authenticated non-premium users.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Renders a video card component in either 'default' or 'compact' variant, displaying thumbnail, title, channel name, view count, and upload time with navigation to the video page.
frontend/src/components/VideoEditModal.t: A dialog modal for editing video metadata (title, description, tags) and managing thumbnails, with tabbed UI and save/remove actions.
frontend/src/components/VideoQualitySele: A dropdown UI component for selecting video playback quality (auto, 360p–1080p), currently only managing local state without affecting actual playback.
frontend/src/components/VideoRating.tsx: Interactive 5-star rating component that shows the average rating display and allows authenticated users to rate a video, with hover effects and current user rating feedback.
frontend/src/components/VideoRatingDispl: Read-only star rating display component that fetches and renders average rating and total rating count with full, half, and empty star visuals.
frontend/src/components/VideoSettings.ts: A card-based settings panel for managing a video's thumbnail, allowing users to add, change, or remove the thumbnail via the ThumbnailSelector component.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddComment.ts: Mutation hook that submits a comment for a video via the backend actor and invalidates related queries on success, with toast notifications for feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useAverageRating.ts: Query hook that fetches the average star rating for a given video ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useChannelName.ts: Query hook that fetches and caches a channel display name for a given principal, falling back to the principal string if unavailable.
frontend/src/hooks/useComments.ts: Query hook that fetches the list of comments for a given video ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Mutation hook that creates a Stripe checkout session via the backend actor, parsing the response and returning the session ID and redirect URL.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteVideo.ts: React Query mutation hook that deletes a video by ID via the actor, invalidates video queries, and shows success/error toasts.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAdRevenueForCal: React Query hook that fetches the total ad revenue for the currently authenticated caller from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAdRevenueForVid: React Query hook that fetches ad revenue stats (impressions and total revenue) for a specific video by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook that fetches the authenticated caller's user profile, with custom loading/fetched state that accounts for actor initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserRating.ts: React Query hook that retrieves the authenticated user's star rating for a specific video by searching their ratings list.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserSubscriptio: React Query hook that fetches the caller's subscription status and maps it to a structured object describing free vs. premium feature access.
frontend/src/hooks/useIncrementVideoView: React Query mutation hook that increments the view count for a video and invalidates related video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, and persisted identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarkThumbnailGener: React Query mutation hook that marks a video's thumbnail as generated by submitting a thumbnail blob to the actor and invalidates related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useMultiAccount.ts: Hook that manages multiple Internet Identity accounts stored in localStorage, supporting adding, removing, and switching accounts with query cache clearing.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhoto.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single photo by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotos.ts: React Query hook that fetches the list of all photo metadata from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotoUpload.ts: React Query mutation hook that uploads a photo file with progress tracking, converting it to Uint8Array before sending to the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useRateVideo.ts: React Query mutation hook that submits a star rating for a video and invalidates all related rating and video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useRecordAdImpression: React Query mutation hook that records an ad impression for a video and invalidates ad revenue queries, silently ignoring errors.
frontend/src/hooks/useRemoveThumbnail.ts: React Query mutation hook that removes a video's thumbnail via the actor and invalidates related video queries with appropriate error toasts.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook that saves the caller's user profile to the backend and invalidates profile and channel name queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchVideos.ts: React Query hook that searches videos by term, fetching full video data for each result returned by the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetChannelName.ts: React Query mutation hook that validates and sets the caller's channel name via the actor, with client-side length validation and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetCustomThumbnail: React Query mutation hook that uploads a custom thumbnail blob for a video with progress tracking and invalidates related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetSubscriptionSta: Mutation hook that calls the backend `setSubscriptionStatus` for a given user principal and invalidates the `userSubscriptionStatus` query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useStripeConfig.ts: Provides two hooks: `useIsStripeConfigured` to query whether Stripe is configured, and `useSetStripeConfiguration` to update the Stripe configuration via mutation.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscribe.ts: Mutation hook for subscribing to a channel; currently throws a placeholder error since the backend subscription feature is not yet implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscriptionStatus: Query hook that returns the subscription status for a given channel principal; always returns false as a placeholder until the backend is implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useTotalRatings.ts: Query hook that fetches the total ratings count for a given video ID from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateVideo.ts: Mutation hook that updates a video's title, description, and tags, then invalidates related video queries and shows a toast notification.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpgradeAccount.ts: Mutation hook for upgrading a user account to premium; currently a stub that always throws since the backend upgrade functionality is not yet implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserStats.ts: Query hook that fetches `UserStats` for a given principal from the backend, caching results for 5 minutes.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideo.ts: Query hook that fetches a single `ExtendedVideo` by video ID from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoLike.ts: Mutation hook that likes a video via the backend and invalidates the videos and individual video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideos.ts: Query hook that fetches the full list of `VideoMetadata` from the backend via `listVideos`.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoUpload.ts: Mutation hook that converts a File to Uint8Array and uploads it to the backend with progress tracking, handling various error types with toast notifications.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/pages/ChannelProfile.tsx: Page component that displays a channel's profile including their videos and photos, with edit/delete controls shown when the current user is the channel owner.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page that fetches and displays all videos sorted by upload time in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Page displayed after a failed or cancelled payment, offering buttons to retry the upgrade or return to the home page.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Handles the post-Stripe payment redirect by verifying the session via the canister actor and displaying loading, success, or error states. Invalidates subscription-related React Query caches on successful verification.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoGallery.tsx: Displays a searchable, debounced grid of all photos fetched via the usePhotos hook. Shows loading, error, and empty states with a responsive PhotoCard grid layout.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoViewer.tsx: Renders a single photo detail page by fetching photo data by ID, converting the raw Uint8Array to a blob URL for display, and showing metadata including uploader and upload date.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Shows the authenticated user's profile with tabs for their uploaded videos, photos, and ad revenue dashboard. Supports video editing and deletion, and redirects unauthenticated users to sign in.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Provides a settings page where authenticated users can update their profile name and channel name, and view their current subscription tier (free or premium).
frontend/src/pages/Shorts.tsx: Static placeholder page indicating that short-form video functionality is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/Subscriptions.tsx: Static placeholder page for channel subscriptions, showing a coming-soon message for authenticated users or a sign-in prompt for unauthenticated visitors.
frontend/src/pages/Upgrade.tsx: Displays a pricing/upgrade page with Free and Premium plan cards, handles Stripe checkout session creation, and shows the user's current subscription status.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPhoto.tsx: Provides a photo upload form with title, description, and file input fields, showing upload progress and a success state with navigation options.
frontend/src/pages/UploadVideo.tsx: Provides a video upload form with title, description, tags, and file validation, supporting thumbnail selection after upload and retry/reset functionality.
frontend/src/pages/VideoGallery.tsx: Renders a searchable grid gallery of videos, debouncing the search input and switching between all-videos and search-result queries accordingly.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPlayer.tsx: Plays a single video by ID, tracking watched seconds to increment view counts and record ad impressions, and displays related videos, comments, likes, ratings, and owner edit/delete controls.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Exports two utility functions: formatViewCount converts a BigInt view count to a human-readable string (K/M/B), and formatTimeAgo converts a nanosecond timestamp to a relative time string.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended border radius, Inter font family, and accordion keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for 'Media Share' tracking existing features (Stripe subscription fix, ad revenue dashboard UI) and pending new feature requests (subscription fix, ad revenue backend with CPM-based impression tracking).
